title: 第24章 邻居消息！圣宝楼！
novel_title: 从暮年娶妻到长生不死
content_zh:
主座位置没有了争论，宋达父子坐下。

    沈云这段时间才知道，当年在觅仙城选拔来圣宗的人，不是全部都入宗成功了。

    道基三三以上，十八岁前通过考核，可入圣宗为外门弟子。

    道基四四以上，则是可以直入圣宗。

    宋子辰道基三八，走的是第一条路线。

    鲜衣怒马少年郎，得入圣宗，宋子辰正是意气风发的时候。

    交谈间，对于灵农坊内旧邻，多了几分高高在上的意味。

    和这些老邻居没有多少共同语言。

    热情过后大家都察觉到了这点，也没热脸贴冷屁股。

    “子辰入圣宗，未来都是年轻人的天下了。”

    一口灵米酿下肚，刘老感慨道。

    “刘老，你真应该学学沈老哥，不如娶妻安享晚年，还说不定能老来得子。”

    宋达看向满头银发的刘老，以前他种田还要求他帮忙，不敢多说。

    今日父凭子贵，忍不住好心劝道：“辅修入阶拜入圣宗太难，您都这么大年纪，是时候放弃了。”

    沈云闻言有些诧异，不知道此前刘老竟是打的这个主意。

    辅修入圣宗。

    对面刘老眼中闪过迷茫，这么多年下来，这成了他的执念。

    可距离真正的灵植师，始终只差一线。

    就是差那么一线迈不过去，越老越看不到希望。

    今日见年轻一代的宋子辰拜入圣宗，他心中坚持的那口气有点泄了。

    老了，终究是老了。

    “沈老弟确实比我过得自在，好歹临死前能享受几年”

    目光略过沈云，刘老不着痕迹的看了一眼林巧娘，思索起来。

    “不能拿勉强入阶的沈老头和随时都能成灵植师的刘老比较，一个靠着运气，一个靠能力。”

    卫虎看刘老沉默半晌不说话，连忙开口解围，“圣城不是没有大器晚成的例子。”

    卫虎的孩子资质一般，跟着他去蛮荒搏命不如学灵植辅修，所以一直想讨好刘老。

    可是听闻此言，酒桌上不少人皱起眉头。

    卫虎一踩一捧令人不喜，况且今日是沈云举办的酒席，还拿灵酒蛮兽肉招待他们。

    俏寡妇林巧娘不悦道：“卫虎，你说这话是什么意思....”

    “我与沈老弟情况不同，不必多说。”

    刘老也回过神来，连忙打断争执：“沈老弟好酒好菜招待我们，谈些开心事。”

    “我兄弟快人快语，说话不过脑子，这杯酒，先干为敬。”

    卫蛟拉起卫虎，打着圆场，弟弟太着急了，怕引起刘老不满。

    虽然同住一个巷子，邻居街坊看起来差不多。

    但这终究是个修行世界，很多人看沈云不过是个好运的老头，不配与他们为伍。

    作为当事人，沈云分外无语。

    这些日子低调谨慎，与人为善，没想到还是会躺枪。

    “弱者与人相交只会被认为示好。”
content_en:
There was no longer any debate over the main seat, and Song Da and his son sat down.

    It was only during this period that Chen Yun learned that not all the people who were selected to join the Holy Sect in Findian City were successful in joining the sect.

    If you have a Taoist foundation of 33 or above and pass the examination before the age of 18, you can join the Holy Sect as an outer disciple.

    If you have a Taoist foundation of 44 or above, you can directly enter the Holy Sect.

    Song Zichen's Daoji was 38, and he took the first route.

    A young man in bright clothes and an angry horse was admitted to the Holy Sect. Song Zichen was in high spirits.

    During the conversation, there was a bit of condescension towards the old neighbors in Lingnongfang.

    We don't have much in common with these old neighbors.

    After the enthusiasm passed, everyone realized this and didn't show any enthusiasm.

    "When Zichen joins the Holy Sect, the future will be dominated by young people."

    After taking a mouthful of spiritual rice, Mr. Liu sighed with emotion.

    "Mr. Liu, you really should learn from Brother Shen. Why don't you marry a wife and enjoy your old age, and maybe you can have children in your old age."

    Song Da looked at the silver-haired Mr. Liu. He used to ask him for help when farming, so he didn't dare to say anything more.

    Today, because of the value of the son, the father could not help but kindly advise: "It is too difficult to become a minor and join the Holy Sect. You are so old, it is time to give up."

    Chen Yun was a little surprised when he heard this. He didn't know that Mr. Liu had this idea before.

    Minored in the Holy Sect.

    Opposite me, Mr. Liu's eyes flashed with confusion. After so many years, this has become his obsession.

    But there is always only a thin line between being a true spiritual planter.

    There is just such a thin line that cannot be overcome, and the older we get, the less hope we see.

    Today, when he saw the younger generation Song Zichen join the Holy Sect, the insistence in his heart was a little discouraged.

    Getting old is getting old after all.

    "Brother Shen is indeed living a more comfortable life than me. At least he can enjoy it for a few years before he dies."

    Looking past Shen Yun, Mr. Liu glanced at Lin Qiaoniang without any trace and began to think.

    "You can't compare Old Shen who barely entered the level with Old Liu who can become a spiritual planter at any time. One relies on luck and the other relies on ability."

    Seeing that Mr. Liu was silent for a long time, Wei Hu quickly spoke to the rescue, "It's not like there are no examples of late bloomers in the Holy City."

    Wei Hu's child has average qualifications. Following him to fight for his life in the wilderness is not as good as learning Lingzhi as a minor, so he always wants to please Mr. Liu.

    But after hearing this, many people at the wine table frowned.

    Wei Hu stepped on them and gave them a handful of food, which made them unhappy. Moreover, today was a banquet hosted by Shen Yun, and he also entertained them with spirit wine and beast meat.

    The pretty widow Lin Qiaoniang said displeasedly: "Wei Hu, what do you mean by this..."

    "Brother Shen and I are in different situations, so there is no need to say more."

    Mr. Liu also came to his senses and quickly interrupted the argument: "Brother Shen entertained us with wine and food, and we talked about some happy things."

    "My brother is quick to talk and can't speak his mind. I'd like to drink this glass of wine first as a token of respect."

    Wei Jiao pulled up Wei Hu and tried to smooth things over. The younger brother was too anxious and was afraid of causing dissatisfaction with Mr. Liu.

    Although we live in the same alley, our neighbors look similar.

    But this is a world of cultivation after all, and many people see Shen Yun as just a lucky old man who is not worthy of being associated with them.

    As a person involved, Shen Yun was extremely speechless.

    These days, I am low-key, cautious, and kind to others. I never expected that I would still be exposed.

    "A weak person who associates with others will only be considered a sign of kindness."
title_en: Chapter 24 News from neighbors! Holy Treasure Tower!
